rules.title: Await Promises
rules.check: All Promises must be awaited or explicitly handled. Floating promises are forbidden.
rules.rationale: Unhandled promises swallow errors silently. They indicate fire-and-forget patterns that lose error context.

rules.title: AbortSignal Required
rules.check: Long-running async operations must accept AbortSignal for cancellation.
rules.rationale: Without cancellation, operations continue after callers no longer need results. AbortSignal enables graceful cancellation.

rules.title: Timeout All Requests
rules.check: All external requests must have explicit timeouts configured.
rules.rationale: Without timeouts, external failures hang indefinitely. Timeouts enable graceful degradation and resource protection.

rules.title: Promise.all for Parallel
rules.check: Independent concurrent operations must use Promise.all, not sequential await.
rules.rationale: Sequential await of independent operations wastes time. Promise.all enables concurrent execution.

rules.title: Promise.allSettled for Resilience
rules.check: Concurrent operations that should not fail together must use Promise.allSettled.
rules.rationale: Promise.all fails fast on first rejection. allSettled enables partial success handling.

rules.title: No Async IIFE
rules.check: Async immediately-invoked function expressions are forbidden. Use named functions or proper async initialization.
rules.rationale: Async IIFEs hide complexity and make errors hard to trace. Named functions improve debugging and testing.

rules.title: Error Propagation
rules.check: Async functions must either handle errors or propagate them. Swallowing errors is forbidden.
rules.rationale: Swallowed errors make debugging impossible. Error propagation ensures issues are visible.

rules.title: Race Condition Prevention
rules.check: State mutations in async contexts must account for race conditions.
rules.rationale: Async operations can complete out of order. State mutations without protection cause data corruption.

rules.title: Retry Logic
rules.check: Transient failure scenarios must implement retry with exponential backoff.
rules.rationale: Transient failures are common in distributed systems. Proper retry improves reliability without overwhelming services.

rules.title: No Callback Hell
rules.check: Callback-based APIs must be wrapped in Promises. Nested callbacks are forbidden.
rules.rationale: Callback nesting creates unreadable code. Promise wrappers enable async/await usage.

rules.title: Async Generators for Streaming
rules.check: Use async generators (async function*) for streaming data instead of collecting into arrays.
rules.rationale: Generators yield items one at a time, reducing memory usage. They enable processing before full data is available.

rules.title: No Promise Constructor Anti-pattern
rules.check: Avoid wrapping existing promises in new Promise(). Return the promise directly.
rules.rationale: Unnecessary Promise wrapping adds overhead and can swallow errors. It indicates misunderstanding of promise chaining.
